_comment: APPROVED BLOG POST MERGES, DESCRIBED ONCE.
Each entry retires the near-duplicate post `from` in favour of the post `to` that stays.
The `merges` list controls the retained site's blog rendering and its search/RSS exclusions:
src/lib/public-blog.ts  excludes `<from>` from pages, listings and related entries
scripts/blog-merges.js   applies the exclusion to the search index, llms.txt and RSS
This file does not apply Amplify Hosting redirects. If a merge needs a 301,
review and update the live Amplify customRules separately; ensure no removed source
page is still served at HTTP 200 or included in the sitemap.
Setting each `from` post to draft in Blog Studio is separate owner cleanup for the other
readers of /api/seo-tools/blog-public. Nothing here depends on it.
Add an entry only with the owner's approval and only when `to` is published.
